list.title: Financing
list.description: CANG never lends. We score your company, route your file to licensed partners and you deal with them directly.
list.emptyDescription: Apply for import financing against an order and we route the file to a licensed partner in minutes.
list.partners: Partners you can be routed to
list.partnersHint: Licensed lenders and factoring companies that cover your country.

score.title: Your credit score
score.hint: Computed from your trading record on CANG using the platform's published scoring rules.
score.noneHint: Submit an application, or recompute now, to see your score.
score.features: What the score is based on

form.title: Apply for financing
form.description: Tell us what you need. We score your company, pick the partner whose appetite matches and hand over the file.
form.orderHint: Optional, but an order makes approval faster.
form.purposePlaceholder: e.g. Pay the 30% deposit on order ORD-2026-KW5C76 while our receivables clear.
form.financialsHint: Optional — helps the partner size the facility.
form.documentsHint: Bank statements, audited accounts, receivables ageing. Visible only to our compliance team and the partner.
form.consent: I authorise CANG to share my company profile, trading record and credit score with the matched financing partner.
form.consentHint: Required — without it we cannot route your application.

productHints.IMPORT_FINANCING: Finance an import order and repay after the goods arrive.
productHints.PURCHASE_FINANCING: The partner pays your supplier; you repay on agreed terms.
productHints.BNPL: Short deferral on a single order.
productHints.WORKING_CAPITAL: A revolving line for your sourcing programme.

detail.title: Application {number}
detail.notRoutedHint: No partner matched automatically — our team reviews the file manually.
detail.noOffers: No offer yet. The partner is reviewing your file.
detail.acceptDescription: The partner will contact you to complete the documentation. Other offers on this application are declined.
detail.withdrawDescription: The partner is informed and any open offer lapses.
detail.disclaimer: CANG is not a lender. Credit decisions, funding and repayment terms are the responsibility of the licensed partner shown above.
